purpose: A Smart template reads the value its component resolved, not the raw attribute. Each component is rendered with no attribute and with each declared attribute set in turn to each value its manifest allows (an arbitrary value where it names none); every key the template reads from its context, where the component defines a getter of that name, equals that getter. Empty values (null, undefined, '', false) count as equal.
why: Three defects in two days had one cause: a template context built from attributes rather than resolved values (sf-tag size, sf-tag line, sf-tag kind="checkbox" rendering an inert box). The first run of this check found the same cause in nine more components, among them sf-list-item never drawing its checkbox, sf-input appearance="hidden" not rendering a hidden input, sf-modal blur="false" turning the blur on and sf-textarea maxlength="x" rendering maxlength=0.

exemptions.reason: The template takes the text to display: the text attribute, else initials from the heading or the accessible name.
The template takes the items with the current crumb, the folded ones and the siblings resolved (normalizedItems): a single item is the current one; the getter returns the items as given.
The template takes the line drawn: count-text, else the bar's words for the count («0 selected»); the getter returns count-text as given (empty: the bar's words).
Two meanings of one name: the template's shown is whether the bar is drawn (a count above 0, a run or a result); the getter is the base's §4.1 state (the element has a box in an opened container).
Two meanings of one name: the template's shown is whether the panel is open (the panel layout, or open); the getter is the base's §4.1 state (the element has a box in an opened container).
While preparing without a value the template draws the spinner (value absent, null); the getter reads the absent optional number as 0.
The template takes the words with the file's name put in («Download report.pdf»); the getter returns the words' pattern («Download {name}»).
The template takes the words with the file's name put in («Remove report.pdf», «Delete …» for a stored file); the getter returns the words' pattern («Remove {name}»).
The template takes the message shown: only while the field is invalid (sfShownMessage); the getter returns error-message as given.

The template hands the written maxlength to the native input when the field does not count (a masked field keeps the native limit: the mask decides the length); the getter is the counted limit, a whole number above 0 or null.
The template takes the flow drawn: auto resolved to row or column by the options (C165 (3), flowValue); the getter returns the setting as given.

The template takes the host's readonly (valueLocked: no typing, no calendar); the getter also counts a range, which is only «not typed» and still opens its calendar (RG-DP-5).
The template takes the sources as a list (listOf: device, library, url); the getter returns the setting as written, a string.

The template takes the message shown: only while the field is invalid (sfShownMessage); the getter returns error-message as given.
The template takes whether the field grows (growing): a flush field and rows given without auto-grow do not; the getter returns the setting as given.
The template takes the message shown: only while the field is invalid (sfShownMessage); the getter returns error-message as given.
The template takes the rows a growing field stops at: max-rows, else 10 (a flush field no cap) (growMaxRows); the getter returns the setting as given.
The template takes the rows a growing field starts at: min-rows, else rows, else 3 (a flush field 1) (growMinRows); the getter returns the setting as given.
The template turns spelling off for code text (text="code"); the getter returns the setting as given.
The template takes the chosen ids as a set while the list selects (empty otherwise); the getter returns them as a list of ids.
The template takes the leading place the skeleton rows keep (leadingPlace: auto resolved by the rows shown); the getter returns the setting as given.
The template takes the window drawn full screen: fullscreen, size full, or a phone's full screen (shownFullscreen, C159 (2)); the getter returns the setting as given.
The template takes the window's size by name (windowSize, C159 (1)): no size, or auto, is a form; the getter returns the setting as given.
The template takes the level's steps (levelSteps): absent is no level (null); the getter reads the absent optional number as 0.
Two meanings of one name: the template's name is the field's visible name (label, C153); the getter is the form name the value is submitted under.
The template takes the digits the props context reads (0 for a value that is not a number); the getter reads it as unset (null), the digits then come from step.
The template takes the initial value (value, else start, else 0) as the slider's start; the getter returns the start attribute as given.
The template takes the items with their index, stage and selection resolved (computedItems).
The template takes the items with their index, slots and selection resolved.

undefined_reads_rule: A component reads a declared prop through a getter it defines or through this.getProp(key), never off this bare: static props creates no accessor, so this.<prop> is undefined whatever the attribute says. Checked statically in the node gate (tests/undeclared-prop-reads.contract.test.mjs) and at runtime by the browser test. An exemption here is a known defect with its owner; one that no longer reads bare fails, so the list cannot go stale.
